product_metadata.title: Homey Product - Set of 6 Fondue Forks - Rust Resistant Stainless Steel Skewer Sticks with Natural Bare Oak Wood Handles - 9.5" and Perfect for Melted Cheese, Meat, Fruit and More
features: SAFE TOP QUALITY MATERIALS - Our forks are made from special food grade, rust resistant stainless steel, which will stay polished and sharp after repeat use with any foods, from veggies to meats. There are no plastic pieces around insertion of the wood handles.

NATURAL OAK WOODEN HANDLES - The fork handles are bare oak. Other than the color coded pieces on the bottom, there are no plastic or rubber pieces or paints to melt around heat (logos are laser-etched into the wood). The handles are heat insulated and light weight.

PERFECT SIZE AND WEIGHT - One of the reason for our materials is to offer the best build and weight balance. The stainless steel is light but is slightly heavier than the light oak handles. This keeps the weight of the forks at the front, so you can rest them on the edge of your dish, without them sliding and falling inside. The length is 9.5 inches, popular for most fondue forks.

COLOR CODED - Each fork has a little button of different color attached to the end of each handle so that you can tell the forks apart without accidentally mixing things up. Each person gets their own and keeps using their own.
100% MONEYBACK GUARANTEE - We are so happy with our forks that we will guarantee satisfaction of your money back.
